newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three Israelis wounded in Lebanon fighting.
newsitem.headline: Three Israelis wounded in Lebanon fighting.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were wounded, one seriously, when they came under anti-tank fire from Lebanese guerrillas in south Lebanon on Sunday, the army said.
It said an Israeli force came under anti-tank fire while chasing two guerrilla groups in the western sector of the Israeli-occupied "security zone".
It said mortars were also fired at Israeli forces.
Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah said its fighters mounted two attacks against Israeli forces in south Lebanon on Sunday, causing casualties and damage.
Sunday was "Martyr's Day" when Hizbollah (Party of God) commemorates fighters killed in confrontations with Israeli forces.
Hizbollah said in a statement in Beirut it opened fire twice at an armoured force in the Basseel area, "inflicting a number of casualties, dead and wounded".

On Saturday, Hizbollah guerrillas killed an Israeli soldier and wounded two when they opened machinegun and anti-tank rocket fire at an Israeli post at Blat in the western sector of the occupation zone.
Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war in a bid to oust Israeli and allied militia forces from the 15-km (nine-mile) deep zone in south Lebanon.
Some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000-strong pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militia patrol the zone set up in 1985 to deter cross-border guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
